proposal: 2 tanks of 30 m3 (27 t of 24.5 % solution each): 7 days on gas per tank, 72 h on LDO from one full and one half-full tank; unloading from 25 t road tankers.
question: ER-06.04 requires aqueous ammonia storage for 2 x 7 days at base load. SCR consumption is 125 kg/h on gas and 480 kg/h on LDO (TQ-IEC-018). 7 days on gas is 21 t per tank; 72 h on LDO (the LDO storage autonomy, ER-03.08) needs 34.6 t. Please confirm the basis: 2 x 7 days on gas, and the total also covering 72 h of LDO operation.
response: Accepted: 2 x 30 m3 as proposed; ER-06.04 clarified. The ammonia inventory (about 54 t) is added to the major accident notification (PMT-015).
subject: Aqueous ammonia storage basis (ER-06.04)
